notes.title: DRACOMATON 1.3.3 - The Smoothie Update
notes.content: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44299090/5f7305acd75ec6b83e997eee4fb9cdabe1c3366c.png"][/img][/p][p]Hi y'all! It's Calex and Annie; a bit of a shorter one this time but we wanted to push out a quick update with some bug fixes and for QOL.[/p][p][/p][p]As always, it's been overwhelmingly amazing to see your support for the game! Your energy is infectious; we may not have been working on the game very much before, but this has given us a little boost this past month.[/p][p][/p][p]For you all who have stuck with us so far... thank you! We have so many thanks to give, and in the meantime, those thanks have taken on many forms. This empty, abandoned factory, and the smothered night sky may yet still have more secrets to share.[/p][p][/p][p]See you all in a month.[/p][p][/p][h2]Patch Notes:[/h2][p align="start"][/p][h3]Modifiers[/h3][list][*][p]Added two new modifiers[/p][list][*][p]Bolt Room chance modifier: Modifies the chance for bolt reward rooms.[/p][/*][*][p]Mod EXP modifier: A multiplier on the amount of XP that gets funneled into your mods.[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][p][/p][h3]Misc[/h3][list][*][p]Improved room boundary collision (the smoothening)[/p][/*][*][p]Minor enemy balance changes[/p][/*][*][p]A Gun Jumpers Ko-Fi link has been added to the main menu.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3]Bug Fixes[/h3][list][*][p]Fixes to bolt spawn rates[/p][/*][*][p]Fixes to Flame Form Evo 2: Oil Leak[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug with room turrets not firing[/p][/*][*][p]Miscellaneous bug fixes and optimizations[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: DRACOMATON Bugfix and Optimization Patch / Merch Store
notes.content:
[p]  Hey everyone, this is Benji from the GUN JUMPERS. Thank you so much for support the last couple weeks, it’s been so wonderful to see everyone enjoying the game. I made a piece of LUNR and Eclipse as a thanks, you can take a look at it at the end of the post. 

  We’ve been listening to all of your feedback and reviews of the game, and we have an [b]update[/b] for you! Some of our team has been working really hard to make the game run better for everyone, and to fix all of the bugs that have been reported in both the forums and the discord. The game has been optimized a ton, so if you were having performance issues before that made it difficult for you to enjoy the game, give it another shot! Glitch form has also had a lot of fixes to it, so I’d recommend trying that out as well! [u]The patch notes are listed below.[/u][/p][p]  I’ve also been asked if there was a place where people could buy merch for the game, so I made a merch store! If you like my art and would like to support me, or if you just like some of the characters from the game, feel free to check it out! I’m still in the process of uploading some stuff there, so if there’s anything in particular you’d be interested in, like stickers of a certain form or something, feel free to let me know in the comments.

(wip of a sticker I'm working on)
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44299090/95de71e7a072a6a49c7a630ac0aa3fa014a77082.png"][/img]
 [b][url="https://avianben-shop.fourthwall.com/"]https://avianben-shop.fourthwall.com/[/url][/b]
[/p][p]  Also, if you haven’t joined the discord and would like to here’s the link. I'll update it as I post more stuff to the shop. The community is wonderful, would definitely recommend joining if you like the game:  

[b][url="https://discord.gg/N3gSCaSX3P"]https://discord.gg/N3gSCaSX3P[/url][/b]
[/p][p][u][b]PATCH NOTES: 1.3.2: The Performance and Debug Patch[/b][/u][/p][p]Huge FPS gains across the board[/p][p]New Features: Particle Density slider to control how noisy certain problematic visuals are Various visuals tweaked Death animation and shopkeeper animation implemented.[/p][p]Specific bugs fixed: Hitless no longer has heals or hp ups available in the shop. 
Mod slots are no longer "cancellable" by pressing escape too quickly. 
The next Mod slot to add to is remembered through save and load. 
Backup drive no longer can give infinite lives. 
Save and load no longer heals players.
 Enemies are much less likely to spawn outside of the map. 
More checks to keep the player in bounds. 
Various crashes fixed, generally much more robust. 
Camera shake setting is fixed.[/p][p]Form changes: Spirit's primary now stacks slows. 
Scrapper's Mod now activates every 2 seconds, but shoots much stronger bullets.[/p][p]Glitch form secondary time active reduced to 0.75 seconds from 2.5 seconds. Glitch form no longer has any glitches, sorry guys

Have fun and thanks for playing!!
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44299090/018014ed8286d88a25a69b99d236c1ce8a0f84ba.png"][/img][/p]

notes.title: DRACOMATON 1.3: A Modifiers Update + Some Words On Other Projects!
notes.content: [h2]A Message from Calex:[/h2][p][/p][p]Hi y'all! I'm not usually the one who writes posts like this so cut me some slack on this one. It’s been a while, but we've got a new update to celebrate the anniversary of the game's Steam release. It's a bit of a smaller one, but we hope you enjoy it. The team has been busy battling on other fronts, but we figured we'd celebrate by putting the game up as temporarily free-to-keep from August 1st -> August 4th alongside pushing out a new system and some quality-of-life changes/fixes. As usual, thank you so much for your support since the game's release in the summer of 2023.[/p][p][/p][p]Most of the content in the update is from an experimental branch that we're finally moving into the main game build. We've spent some time fixing various issues in the migration to a new engine version, and it's stable enough now to where all the issues we know of have been resolved. If we get the time and inspiration to jam for another content update, we'll have a nice jumping-off point to go off of thanks to these changes. [/p][p][/p][p]The time since DRACOMATON's initial release has been hectic but exciting for many of us. If you enjoyed the game and are interested in what we're up to, I'd recommend taking a peek at some of our other projects we're currently working on to see if it's your cup of tea.[/p][list][*][p]For the past year and a half, I've been working at Moonshot Games on a PVPVE shooter called [b]Wildgate[/b], centered around spaceship battles between crews in the most dangerous areas of space. Now that it's been announced I can finally talk about it [i]but I'd go on for hours so I won't in this post[/i]. If you're reading this, it's already been released! (So go take a look if you haven't already!)[dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3504780/Wildgate/"][/dynamiclink][/p][/*][*][p]For the past two years, Andrew, Annie, Autumn, Ben, Nik, and Sophie have been working on a psychedelic rhythm-based action platformer about chasing after your heart called [b]Beat, Heart, Beat[/b]. There's a free demo you can play [i]right now[/i], which has a fresh update with the first story mode chapter. I highly recommend giving the demo a try, especially If you enjoy games like Muse Dash or Rhythm Doctor. [dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3239360/Beat_Heart_Beat/"][/dynamiclink][url="https://linktr.ee/beatheartbeatgame"]https://linktr.ee/beatheartbeatgame[/url][/p][/*][*][p]Yiyang, Manas, and Manoj are currently working on a seagull game called [b]Gulltastrophe[/b]. It's a tactical seagull action game where you play as the Seagull, and need to steal their food, poop on their houses, and cause a giant [b]Gulltastrophe.[/b][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3532810/Gulltastrophe/"][/dynamiclink][/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]- Calex[/p][p][/p][h2]Patch Notes:[/h2][p][/p][h3]Modifiers[/h3][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44299090/78c963d8cd79c71ced4c4754129bd3926385d815.png"][/img][/p][p]The game now has modifiers for you to mess around with! You can access the modifier menu by hitting the button on the main menu after you’ve beaten the game at least once. There are plenty of modifiers to mess around with, including the ability to use the old Construct form laser beam. Maybe we'll add more in the future [strike]ˡᶦᵏᵉ ᵗʰᵉ ᵃᵇᶦˡᶦᵗʸ ᵗᵒ ᵘˢᵉ ᶜʰᵃᶦⁿˢᵃʷ ᶠᵒʳᵐ[/strike].[/p][p][/p][p]The list of currently configurable modifiers:[/p][list][*][p]Construct Primary: Spray OR Laser. In Update 1.2 we replaced Construct Form's laser attack with a spray of projectiles. Some players expressed the option to use the old laser, especially since it has some unique form interactions, so you can toggle this using this modifier.[/p][/*][*][p]Cooldown Scalar: You can reduce or increase your form's ability cooldowns using this modifier.[/p][/*][*][p]Time Scale: You can control the overall timescale of the game using this modifier.[/p][/*][*][p]Enemy Damage: Sometimes you just want to relax and turn enemy damage to 10% of what it usually is. Or you can double it if you're into that.[/p][/*][*][p]Enemy Size: Our enemies and rooms were not designed for our enemies to be 50% larger. Change at your own risk.[/p][/*][*][p]Enemy Speed: Watching the whole room instantly swarm you has never been easier.[/p][/*][*][p]Reward Chance (Chaos, Form, Item): These modifiers take the existing chance you would've had for these rewards, and scales based on those odds. If you want to play item-less,,. I guess you can do that now.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3]Miscellaneous[/h3][list][*][p]We've updated the game to a new engine version, Unity 6. This has allowed us to remove the Unity splash screen from the game startup flow, which should let you open the game a little faster now.[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]We've made a couple of polish passes to specific forms and status effects VFX to promote improved visibility throughout the game ([i]Thank you Tracie[/i]).[/p][/*][*][p]Miscellaneous bug fixes.[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: DRACOMATON 1.2: The Whispers Update is now LIVE!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44299090/88c5f782df492e7596b5eab4a88f106c7ad1f918.png[/img]

[h2]A Message from Annie:[/h2]

Hi everyone!! It’s been a bit! Welcome to Version 1.2: The Whispers Update!

This project just refuses to die; it’s too fun to work on. This isn’t and probably never will be our job, but with the rough and tumble world out there, developing new content for DRACOMATON is a bit of an anchor. We hope playing it might do something similar for you!

In any case, it’s been a full year since our Steam release. Thank you for all the support both then and now! When we realized the date was coming up, we did our best to fit all of our in-progress changes into this new update. Me and Calex have been cooking up a storm with two new forms, namely Spirit and Tornado. As always, the indomitable Sophie has also designed some new rooms, with some new faces to fight, designed and animated by the wonderful Benji. Both Sophie and the gracious Autumn have gifted us some new sound effects for all above. 

Calex has also made something for all of us to dirty our hands with to make the game harder, for all you sweats out there: Challenge Modes! So if the current game isn’t quite challenging enough, beat your first run and you’ll have some extra fun options waiting for you in the main menu. Credit to Ryan, Sophie, and Tracie in particular for these meat grinders. 

To be completely honest, on a random day in May, Calex told me off-hand that he was bored, so I jokingly told him to boot up DRACOMATON and we could make a new form on the spot. He doubled down so I followed suit, and subsequently dragged our team into the vortex of working on this game again. I’ve dived into so many sections of the game that I haven’t before, and know a lot more about doing animations and VFX now. Calex has stayed mostly the same from what I can tell; he’s always been the one welding the game together when no one else can.

It’s been a wild couple of months against a wild backdrop of a year, but none of us regret it at all. I hope you all are staying safe and healthy out there, and as the world continues to change, I hope we all continue to find ourselves growing into something new.

Speaking of new things, the members of Gun Jumpers and beyond have also continued to create games! If you haven’t already make sure to check out:

[b]Spared[/b]
[i]Be the last pin standing in this fantasy bowling setting![/i]
[url=https://clxrffdman.itch.io/spared]Play Here![/url]

[b]Beat Heart Beat[/b]
[url=https://x.com/BHB_game]https://twitter.com/BHB_game[/url]



[h2]Patch Notes:[/h2]

[h3]New Forms[/h3]
[b]Spirit:[/b] Summon ghosts and slow enemies!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44299090/ee717412b7ce863ef6ca03f8bdaeb5124744fded.gif[/img]

- Ghost Wave: Shoot a piercing wave that inflicts a slowing Curse.

- Shade Summon: Summon a ghost that follows your crosshair. Killing Cursed enemies makes it stronger.

[b]Tornado:[/b] Blow your foes away and ride the wind!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44299090/9508d036d78d3f29b303333be1b21ac788d4f6b4.gif[/img]

- Pinwheel: Knock enemies away with an exploding shot.

- Tempest: Summon a tornado that boosts the Speed and <#ff5271>Damage</color> of your other projectiles that pass through it.

[h3]New Items[/h3]
[i]Normal Items:[/i]

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44299090/06feea799a2ef3bbdfc7df140512014c60ae81d4.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44299090/b7f4e7e4d7dee3601e37a50d382a4a7d88d5740e.png[/img][/url]
[b]Storykeeper:[/b] Enemies take 0-10% more Damage on based on bestiary progress. Also, gain 0-10% Damage based on room's terminal progress.

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44299090/15e80a5204e0a175af113d9a5d9b63638102be3c.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44299090/6803de4171d7d64cb14f7c697c24b1f866ff2d32.png[/img][/url]
[b]Accelerant:[/b] Projectiles gain a damage bonus based on their velocity.

[i]Challenge Items:[/i]

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44299090/cbf2fad8b7f053c7d38fdf6e9c5cb220e73626a0.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44299090/7176f085d12f5926c70cf19c441972c642a4caf7.png[/img][/url]
[b]Shroom Form:[/b] Your vision changes. Gain 25% Speed and Attack. Gain 40% primary ability cooldown reduction. Your projectiles are 40% smaller.

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44299090/4a96b866140f963b2f148630f8a6628ad50b9a16.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44299090/4b072e1e3dc200f1f3e5ea44469221d530cd893e.png[/img][/url]
[b]Damaging Bolts:[/b] Bolts deal 5 damage to you while a room is active. Bolt pickup range decreased.

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44299090/c5e4f97ef338f845292795719a94eeb7c5548a35.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44299090/e21abccdc07690b751b8b27e4f2b8cbd3101117d.png[/img][/url]
[b]Enemy Cloning:[/b] Enemies are cloned every couple of seconds, depending on how many enemies are remaining in the room.

[h3]New Rooms[/h3]

- 2 new room layouts and 1 miniboss room layout added to the Sun-Dappled Factory (Area 1).

- 1 new miniboss room layout added to the Snowy Surface (Area 2).

[h3]New Hazard[/h3]

[b]Turret: 
[/b]

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44299090/c5602a305abfada59cd248d12771274385d76d1e.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44299090/1180873be2658e85c8c5f55f2e428778b5aba923.png[/img][/url]
Turrets continuously shoot at a pre-determined angle while the room is active. Be mindful of your movement if you encounter them in a room.

[h3]Challenges[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44299090/5841f295fb3048048b9068cb9e3f75e7849d2689.png[/img]

The game now has challenges for you to complete! You can access the challenge menu by hitting the button on the main menu after you’ve beaten the game at least once. Completed challenges will show up in gold. Do your best to complete them all!



[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44299090/af7890e9ad5eadaa7a2c9c0d185384e11d1ef489.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44299090/3aed02dfffc612f420a93e11b5369953e93793a7.png[/img][/url]
[b]Chaotic[/b]: Survive a run with no normal items and an enhanced chance for chaos items!

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44299090/c5e4f97ef338f845292795719a94eeb7c5548a35.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44299090/e21abccdc07690b751b8b27e4f2b8cbd3101117d.png[/img][/url]
[b]Cloning[/b]: Every couple of seconds, all remaining enemies in arena rooms are duplicated! Be mindful of how you spend your time...

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44299090/4a96b866140f963b2f148630f8a6628ad50b9a16.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44299090/4b072e1e3dc200f1f3e5ea44469221d530cd893e.png[/img][/url]
[b]Damaging Bolts[/b]: Picking up bolts while a room is active deals damage to Eclipse! Watch your step...

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44299090/111f622911ee6a4e37389323fb410973238d05fb.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44299090/fb37fa18a2c72baf6a7ad9f573754b97a5244b4c.png[/img][/url]
[b]Hitless[/b]: A trial for the truly insane.

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44299090/c46ed6fb27a04af6f1aacd156a63deac1aca5bc6.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44299090/e54386f008a3832655ec0df7e7ddb89610862147.png[/img][/url]
[b]No Items[/b]: No items or shops. Survive on forms alone.

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44299090/ecd0519baca77878746a03df213a4006fa0d7127.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44299090/4ae00125affa9a8f225043d472273ac3c4cbc9e8.png[/img][/url]
[b]Platformer[/b]: No longer a secret item, Platformer returns as a challenge for the gravity fans out there.

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44299090/cbf2fad8b7f053c7d38fdf6e9c5cb220e73626a0.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44299090/7176f085d12f5926c70cf19c441972c642a4caf7.png[/img][/url]
[b]Shroom Form[/b]: Do not play this challenge if you have photosensitive epilepsy.

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44299090/07beedcebb4f0c008078f80ccd562d5d97e8cfeb.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44299090/a0fb880ca22d82b4d2ad49a1620be35d4fd714f6.png[/img][/url]
[b]The Gauntlet[/b]: Given a preset loadout of forms and items, survive a trial of skill alone.

[h3]New UI Improvements[/h3]

Update 1.2 brings various UI improvements to the game, including but not limited to: item select and inventory frames, the option to enable status icons above enemy health bars, and more!


Item Frames - updated with new visuals. Also has unique visuals for normal versus chaos items.
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44299090/8f9574913369ea75af323f9f5258ac009e3a5ee0.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44299090/b4a392a256c8c76e424c3daf778387c7a77f4984.png[/img][/url]
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44299090/6ee3c77e7874ac8ff94b6cacf5341b075ef2f762.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44299090/2e4cd3393bb400c79fdc9abd13ccd7b3c9004e35.png[/img][/url]


Item Cards - updated with new visuals.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44299090/ce57adaddbe0649f5e58f62e6830d898974426d3.png[/img]


Status Icons - New option in "Visual Settings" that adds status icons to enemy health bars for statuses that have an icon. 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44299090/e0f84d5412ce3e36b564e7f1ad558699dea37147.png[/img]

Magnet: Electromagnet icon updated
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44299090/c67c8e442ecbeaaa3caf4205e3d00c82d2073634.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44299090/4ebcc63f72cd27b2d12b6f16bdb38f98f30ef833.png[/img][/url]

Hunter: Evo Icons updated
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44299090/329656ab045050c9a318206386a34a432d24f63d.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44299090/16e9fdbd4ea38c0abb14da865b2c9406a3111040.png[/img][/url]
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44299090/311d49659a7e4ac481e0cd660759b7b5e57d319e.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44299090/146c1402951089751db583ad700555b378214534.png[/img][/url]

[h3]New Achievements[/h3]

[b]Big Buddy:[/b] Have your ghost grow to over double the base size on Spirit Form.

[b]Blown Away:[/b] Shoot a wind-blast enhanced projectile through two separate tornados..

[b]Damaging Bolts:[/b] Complete "Challenge: Damaging Bolts"

[b]Chaotic:[/b] Complete "Challenge: Chaotic"

[b]Cloning:[/b] Complete "Challenge: Cloning"

[b]No Items:[/b] Complete "Challenge: No Items"

[b]The Gauntlet:[/b] Complete "Challenge: The Gauntlet"

[h3]Form and Item Changes:[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44299090/82e11066c1e4cb727449c70c393f84bd2dcf28f8.gif[/img]
[b]Construct Form Rework:[/b]
- Primary [b]Attack Order[/b] beam replaced with new short range rapid spray.

[b]Battery Overclock[/b] - Above 70% battery, you deal double damage and your projectiles are slightly larger. Your batteries drain 30% faster.

[b]Momentum Spinner[/b] - Damage boost adjusted to flatten over time instead of linearly increasing forever.
[i]Still very powerful but prevents projectiles reaching ridiculous damage boosts (specifically VSynth protective bullets).[/i]

[b]Pinned Down[/b] - Now works by checking speed stat instead of checking for certain status types.

[h3]General Changes + Bug Fixes[/h3]

- Eclipse spawn animation now has increased resolution to account for the camera zoom.
- Steam Rich Presence Support - See the status of your Steam friends runs in real-time!
- Fixed bosses having invulnerability during their stagger phase.
- Regulus roar animations adjusted to fix snapping.
- New tiles have been added to uncover some of the factory flooring on the Snowy Surface.
- Removed accidentally placed lore terminal stuck in wall in one of the rooms on the Snowy Surface.
- Enemy Gunner bullets are despawned properly on room completion
- Death Screen no longer shows enemy ID instead of enemy display name (crawlerExploding -> Starburst Crawler)
- Miscellaneous bug fixes.

notes.title: DRACOMATON 1.1: The Corrosion Update is now LIVE!
notes.content: [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44299090/9f24638660ef231c4eb5371cc7846d7c06428f24.png[/img] [h2]A Message from Benji:[/h2] Hey everyone, this is Benji from the Gun Jumpers team! On behalf of everyone on the team, thank you so much for your support since the release of the game. It was far greater than we ever could have anticipated. This is a post I wanted to write about our team, and Version 1.1: The Corrosion Update coming to DRACOMATON! We formed our team in college for our capstone course and named ourselves the Gun Jumpers. We formed our group before the class even began, because we all shared a similar goal of wanting to make the best game we possibly could. During the course, we had about six months to create a game, and our game ended up becoming DRACOMATON. We were super ambitious in our goals because we all are incredibly passionate about the work we do. Truly, my teammates are some of the most inspiring people I’ve ever had the pleasure of meeting. We poured ourselves into making the game, and it ended up becoming something that we felt we would be proud to release commercially. So after our class ended, we spent an extra month during the summer of 2023 preparing for the Steam release. For myself and everyone else on the team, DRACOMATON is a game that we feel deep pride in creating, and seeing so many people play and enjoy the game has been one of the most fulfilling experiences we’ve ever had. [b]So truly, thank you so much for playing. [/b] Even though we’re all in different stages of our life now, having graduated from college, in December of 2023, we came back together to do a jam for an update. Not everyone could participate, because we all have different obligations we need to attend to, but for those of us who could, we put our all into it. I made a new form called V-Synth form, which is inspired by different Vocal Synths and Vocaloids, and my good friend Tracie made a form called Scrapper form, which is a badass shotgun form. Both of us are artists, so doing all the programming and design work was hard as hell, but with the help of the designers and programmers on the team, we ended up being successful with the forms! Our amazing lead programmer Calex made a leaderboard system, so you’ll now be able to compete for the best completion times in the world and amongst your friends! Our enemy designer Sophie made six more enemies and more rooms to play in as well. I also animated all of those enemies, scrapper, and V-Synth form, AND made new animations for Reggie, aka Regulus, since we weren’t able to make his animations in the original scope of the game. It was a lot of hard work!!! But, I think it will have been worth it, since everyone who’s supported us so far, and new players alike will have a ton of new content to play with in DRACOMATON. Autumn, Annie, Nik, Andrew, and Ryan also did a great amount of work on the update to make some really awesome new content that you’ll be able to see in the Patch Notes below. I can’t promise anything about the future of DRACOMATON, because we’re all just trying to figure out what we want to do after having graduated college. But, the jam we did for the update was a lot of fun, so if we end up making even more stuff for the game, we’ll be sure to let you know. In the meantime, I’d recommend checking our team member’s social media pages if you’d like to see more of our stuff! [spoiler][b]Platform Mode:[/b] Reach the credits with the platformer item in your inventory.[/spoiler] [h3]Form Balance Changes:[/h3] [b]Spider Form Rework:[/b] - Secondary replaced with new ability [b]Spider Bite[/b]. [i]Spiderbite is a high damage single target ability that does massive damage. [i]Tennis form felt unrewarding to use even when properly juggling. Now it has some crazy potential as well as a QOL change with secondary speed and size.[/i] [b]Hunter Form Buffs:[/b] - Hunter primary damage 0.3 -> 0.4. - Hunter primary drain 1 -> 0.6. - Hunter secondary drain 0.5 -> 0.4. - Hunter secondary now procs critical hit items on dash reset (Bug Fix) [i]Hunter form felt unusable for most of the room due to its high battery costs, along with it falling off later on for anything other than a dash. Items now properly interacting will hopefully help it out a bit more late game.[/i] [b]Construct Form Nerfs:[/b] - Construct Beam damage scaling 0.6 -> 0.5 - Construct Beam damage falloff reduced. - Construct Buddies damage scaling 0.6 -> 0.5 [i]This is to help lag in super late game, and prevent auto room clears from being as prevalent Might need to look into Swarm Construct interactions being too limited by the cap.[/i] [b]Flame Status Nerfs:[/b] Changed formula for burn damage, will be the same in the early game and weaker in the late game. [b]Vessel Form Nerfs:[/b] - Vessel Secondary Attack Speed per enemy hit 0.2 -> 0.15 - Vessel Secondary Attack Speed max 0.7 -> 0.4 - Vessel Mod now has a 0.05s cooldown [i]Vessel form has a mainstay niche in being able to destroy bullets, but by giving it less efficiency hopefully it opens up the door to other interesting combos. The mod changes are to help prevent lag in super late game, and prevent auto room clears from being as prevalent. [/i] [b]Magnet Form Nerfs:[/b] - Magnet Primary Bullets increased damage scalar from 0.4 -> 0.6. - Sticky Magnet’s explosion damage 2x -> 1.5x. - Magnet explosion now procs mods less often. - Magnet Secondary Damage Explosion size reduced to better match the visual. - Unstable Magnets damage massively reduced. [i]Unstable Magnets was our most broken mod evolution and hopefully this has addressed insane damage stacking.[/i] [h3]Item Changes[/h3] [b]Detonation Spike[/b] - Explosions deal 25%->20% more damage and are 40% bigger. This effect is on a 5s->10s cooldown. [i]I think this is for sure the best on form switch item, but it also currently has the lowest cooldown.[/i] [b]Hoard[/b] - Gain an extra 5% Damage per 50 Bolts currently owned. Caps at 75%. [i]This item has zero potential to do anything with most of the forms in the game, and then even for forms like tennis where it should be great, it barely does anything. Knockback is funny, but less damage [/i] [b]Safety Plate[/b] - When below 30% health, gain 65%->50% Damage Reduction. [i]Getting a second health bar at no cost that was more efficient with heal pickups was too strong.[/i] [b]Safety Trigger[/b] - When you switch Forms, grant a 15% health shield for 5s->4s. [i]With the shields lasting for half of the item's cooldown, it basically made it so that you can only actually take damage 50% of the time if you are frequently swapping forms. Don’t wanna nerf too bad tho![/i] [b]Battery Overclock[/b] - Above 80% battery, you deal 50% more damage and your projectiles are faster. Your batteries drain 70%->60% faster.
